description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_ajax_url' that generates an AJAX URL based on provided parameters. It includes license and project information related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM, and contains a function that checks for the presence of a 'url' parameter and returns an AJAX link accordingly.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_ajax_url
methods.description: Generates an AJAX URL based on input parameters; triggers an error if required parameters are missing.
